title: Life Time Expands Ultra Fit Class Across North America as Science-Backed Sprint Training Gains Momentum
summary: As more people look for smarter, efficient ways to train for metabolic health, strength and longevity, Life Time (NYSE: LTH), the nation's premier healthy lifestyle brand, is expanding Ultra Fit, its high-intensity Signature Group Training format created by Founder, Chairman and CEO Bahram Akradi, with more than 200 newly certified coaches and new classes across its more than 195 athletic country clubs.

title: Life Time Launches LT Social, Private and Exclusive Events for Members to Meet, Connect and Experience Life Time Beyond the Workout
summary: Life Time (NYSE: LTH), the nation's premier healthy lifestyle brand, today announced the launch of Life Time Social (LT Social), a new social community created for people who want to get out, have fun, and meet others who are interested in a fit and active lifestyle beyond their home club.

title: McKendree Hickory Claims Women's Title in Her Debut at Life Time Leadville Trail 100 Run as Adrian Macdonald Wins Third Men's Victory
summary: McKendree Hickory of Steamboat Springs, Colorado, delivered a breakthrough performance in her first Life Time Leadville Trail 100 Run presented by La Sportiva, winning in 19:39:12. After placing fifth at the Leadville Marathon earlier this summer, Hickory returned to Leadville for her first attempt at the 100-mile distance, steadily working her way through the field before taking the lead late in the race.
